member.name: M:Realm.EditorAPI.IEditorAPI.ApplyGeneratedTerrain(System.Int32,System.Int32,System.ReadOnlySpan{System.SByte},System.ReadOnlySpan{System.Int32},System.Int32)
member.summary: Replaces every terrain cell, splat map entry and pathing code with generated heights and rebuilds the terrain mesh, water, collision and pathing overlay in one authoritative commit. Water is not written here: negative tiers become dry basins, so call afterwards to flood each basin through the same cliff-bounded search the editor water tool uses. Adjacent cell corners are welded to a single height per grid node so the rebuilt surface stays connected.
member.param: Grid width in cells; must match .
Grid depth in cells; must match .
Row-major tier per cell (X fastest). Negative tiers are basins below ground level, zero is flat ground and positive tiers are raised land.
Row-major ground material swatch index per cell, matching the tier array layout.
Swatch index written as a solid weight across the cliff splat map.
member.returns: True when the layout matched the live grid and was committed; otherwise false.

member.name: M:Realm.EditorAPI.IEditorAPI.FillWaterPoolAtCell(System.Int32,System.Int32,System.Single)
member.summary: Flood-fills a water pool from a single terrain cell using the same cliff-bounded search as the editor water tool, and writes a flat water surface at the requested world height. Each filled cell stores the surface offset for its own tier, so the pool reads as one level body of water and the water pathing codes and procedural decals match a pool painted by hand.
member.param: Grid X of the seed cell, normally the deepest cell of a basin.
Grid Z of the seed cell.
World Y of the water surface; the fill stops at terrain that rises above it.
member.returns: True when at least one cell was filled; false when the seed is outside the grid, already wet or cannot spread.
